# New Business Process

*Personal Insurance, BafozAIChallenge-project. Generated by Lens from commit 9309aeb on 2026-09-30.*

New Business Process in BafozAIChallenge-project (Personal Insurance), generated from the code at commit 9309aeb. Screens, rules and data come from the code; sample values are made up.

## The journey

1. **Open contract** (Start)
2. **Link campaign** (Capture)
3. **Capture client details** (Capture)
4. **Link benefits** (Capture)
5. **Capture collection details** (Capture)
6. **Validate new business** (Check)
7. **Activate contract** (Complete)

## 01. Open contract

The system must allow a new contract/policy to be created for a prospective client. A contract must initially be created in a non-active state. Initial status: NEW.

> **Changed:** feat(infra): add DbContractRepository with transaction-scoped writes (NBJ-120)

- **Data:** Stamps contract id, status, created date, modified date on the Contract record.
- **Open question:** INC-2305: Activation fails with NB-REPO-423 when two supervisors approve at once (Open).
- **Open question:** INC-2311: Activation rejected as stale after broker re-captured mobile number (Closed – by design).

| Field | Type | Required | Sample | Stored in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contract id | system |  | CON-000001 | Contract.ContractId |
| Status | system |  | NEW | Contract.Status |
| Created date | system |  | Set on save | Contract.CreatedDate |
| Modified date | system |  | Set on save | Contract.ModifiedDate |

Behind the screen: requirement BR-001; rules none; code src/domain/entities/Contract.cls, src/domain/entities/ContractBenefit.cls, src/api/dto/ContractResponse.cls, src/exceptions/ContractStateException.cls; tests tests/domain/ContractActivationTest.cls, tests/domain/FakeContractValidator.cls, tests/edgecases/EdgeCaseTest.cls, tests/rules/BenefitRequiredRuleTest.cls, tests/rules/CampaignRequiredRuleTest.cls, tests/rules/CollectionDateRequiredRuleTest.cls, tests/rules/CollectionMethodRequiredRuleTest.cls, tests/rules/ContractOwnerRequiredRuleTest.cls, tests/rules/PremiumPositiveRuleTest.cls, tests/services/NewBusinessServiceTest.cls, tests/workflow/NewBusinessWorkflowTest.cls.

- 2026-09-20 feat(infra): add DbContractRepository with transaction-scoped writes (e533edb, NBJ-120)
- INC-2305 Activation fails with NB-REPO-423 when two supervisors approve at once (Open)
- INC-2311 Activation rejected as stale after broker re-captured mobile number (Closed – by design)

## 02. Link campaign

A campaign must be linked to the new contract. Example campaigns: JANUARY2026, SUMMER_CAMPAIGN, DIGITAL_CAMPAIGN, AGENT_CAMPAIGN, PROMOTION_001. A contract may only have one primary campaign.

- **Rule:** NB-CAMPAIGN-001: A campaign must be linked before the contract can be activated. Checked when the application is validated.
- **Data:** Saved to the Contract table: Campaign.
- **Open question:** INC-2324: Contract linked to campaign that expired between capture and activation (Under investigation).

|---|---|---|---|---|
| Campaign | select | yes | CAM001 | Contract.CampaignId |

Behind the screen: requirement BR-002; rules NB-CAMPAIGN-001; code src/domain/entities/Campaign.cls, src/application/services/CampaignService.cls, src/domain/rules/CampaignRequiredRule.cls, src/domain/interfaces/IBusinessRule.cls; tests tests/rules/CampaignRequiredRuleTest.cls.

History:

## 03. Capture client details

The system must capture the person who owns the contract. Required information: Person ID, First Name, Surname, Date of Birth, ID Number, Email, Mobile Number, Address. The person must be linked to the contract.

- **Rule:** NB-PERSON-001: A contract must have an owner before it can be activated. Checked when the application is validated.
- **Rule:** NB-PERSON-002: The contract owner is missing mandatory personal details. Checked when the application is validated.
- **Data:** Saved to the Person table: First name, Surname, Date of birth, Id number, Email, Mobile number, Address.
- **Data:** Owner person id links this record to the person captured in an earlier step.

## 04. Link benefits

The client must select one or more benefits. Example benefits: LIFE, FUNERAL, ACCIDENT, DISABILITY, CRITICAL_ILLNESS, HOSPITAL. Each selected benefit must be linked to the contract.

> **Changed:** feat(infra): add DbContractRepository with transaction-scoped writes (NBJ-120)

- **Rule:** NB-BENEFIT-001: At least one benefit must be selected. Checked when the application is validated.

## 05. Capture collection details

The system must capture how and when premiums will be collected. Collection method examples: DEBIT_ORDER, EFT, CARD, PAYROLL, CASH. Collection date must also be captured.

> **Changed:** fix(domain): restrict recurring monthly collection day to 1-28 (NB-COLLECTION-002) (NBJ-127)
